title: What It Actually Looks Like to Own Your Sin and Still Rest in Grace
caption:
Owning your sin and resting in grace aren't opposites. A man needs both.

Call it what it is, refuse the self-punishment, fix what you broke, and get up tonight. Save this for the night after you fall.

#faith #grace #godlyman #repentance #romans8
theme: He's hard on himself, gentle with others.
